text.tspan: Higher Levels of Integrity in Public Function Achieved
Roles and responsibilities of public officials clearly defined within a modern structure of the overall
Standards of transparency and merit applied and respected in the appointment of
employees/interns/volunteers and their transfer, promotion, compensation, and fringe benefits
A modern and integrated system to promote ethical behavior in public administrations, including
institutions and municipalities, established and implemented
Independence and effectiveness of the Civil Service Board enhanced
